items.evidence: Net sales and operating income, as determined in accordance with generally accepted accounting principles, are used as the performance measures for the annual cash incentive program
Actual annual cash incentive payouts are determined based on an equal weighting for the net sales and operating income measures
The number of performance-based RSUs that vest depends on Apple's total shareholder return relative to the other companies in the S&P 500 ("Relative TSR")
